By Advs.
 M.Narendra Kumar
 Harshadev M.
Respondents:
 Karunapuram Grama Panchayat,
 Represented By Its Secretary,
 Office Of The Grama Panchayat, Koottar P.O.,
 Idukki District, Pin-685552.
Smt.V.H.Jasmine(Sc)

THIS WRIT PETITION (CIVIL) HAVING COME UP FOR ADMISSION ON 01.07.2022, THE COURT ON THE SAME DAY DELIVERED THE FOLLOWING:
 WP(C) NO. 21034 OF 2022  2  JUDGMENT Dated this the 1st day of July, 2022
The petitioner approached this Court aggrieved by denial of renewal of licence for conducting meat stall.

2. When the writ petition came up for hearing today, the Standing Counsel representing the Grama Panchayat submitted that the application submitted by the petitioner for renewal of licence has been considered and renewal is granted in favour of the petitioner.

Ansari vs Karunapuram Grama Panchayat on 1 July, 2022 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/87144837/

In view of the above, no further orders are necessary in the writ petition.
The writ petition is closed recording the above submission.

Sd/-
